description: Pages for therapist sites built from sanitised HTML and a fixed set of components, with version history, style packs and bundled fonts.
changelog:
0.2.4

  • The resources component styles the articles plugin grid from the active pack. No effect when that plugin is absent.

0.2.3

  • Minimum text sizes: body 16px, eyebrows and small text 14px.
  • Text on bands and buttons reaches 4.5:1 contrast in both packs.

0.2.2

  • Fix: two-column layouts (image and text, text with aside) fill the full container width.
  • The narrow text layout is one centred column.

0.2.1

  • New: the plugin can now update itself from the Plugins screen. It checks for a newer version every 12 hours, and a "Check for updates" link on the plugin row checks straight away.
  • Every update is checked against a checksum before it is installed. If the file does not match, nothing is installed.

0.2.0

  • The one-h1 rule and theme title hiding, eleven components with variants, component styles, style packs (sage and grove), bundled fonts, and the component gallery.

0.1.0

  • First release: page store with version history, the sanitiser, the [twd_page] shortcode and WP-CLI commands.
